warning.title: Read this before turning it on
warning.body: A custom domain routes your traffic through an extra network hop. In many cases this actually makes the connection slower, laggier, or even drops it. If the direct address works fine for you, leave this off. Only turn it on if the direct address is completely unreachable. This feature is provided by Cloudflare; all traffic passes through Cloudflare’s servers.
